OUR STORY

More Than 20 Years of Car Rental Experience

Chand Rent A Car is a Lahore-based car rental company with more than 20 years of experience serving individuals, families, business professionals, visitors and organizations with practical transportation solutions.

Over two decades of experience have taught us that a successful car rental service is about much more than simply providing a vehicle. Customers need clear communication, convenient booking, comfortable transportation, flexible rental options and dependable support throughout their journey.

Our experience covers a wide range of transportation requirements, including airport transfers, chauffeur car rental, self-drive car rental, corporate transportation, wedding car rental, daily and monthly rentals and outstation travel.

Whether you need a luxury vehicle for an important occasion, an executive car for business travel, a family vehicle for a trip, or a dependable car for daily transportation, our team focuses on understanding the requirement first and then arranging a suitable rental option.

TWO DECADES OF EXPERIENCE

Experience That Makes Every Rental Journey Easier

More than 20 years in the car rental industry have given Chand Rent A Car valuable experience in understanding how customers travel and what they expect from a professional rental service.

From an individual looking for a car for a few days to a business requiring regular transportation, every customer can have different requirements. Some customers need convenience, some need flexibility, some prefer a chauffeur, while others prefer the freedom of self-drive.

Our long-standing experience helps us approach these different requirements with a practical understanding of rental travel, vehicle selection and customer service.

We continue to build our service around convenient bookings, flexible rental options, a diverse vehicle selection and clear communication with customers.
